title: My Grammar Drills Now Follow a Real Textbook | vitalii.no
description:
My listening app could generate vocabulary lessons fine, but the grammar drills I mixed in were just random irregular-verb sentences with no structure — no sense of progression, no connection to the textbook I was actually working through, and no one checking whether the Norwegian generated for me was actually correct.

I added a table that defines drill types alternating between irregular-verb practice and the syllabus of the textbook I study from, with page references pulled from scanned copies of the book. Generated drills are stored as reusable blocks in the database — once a block exists it gets reused instead of regenerated, and when a new one is needed the planner avoids topics used recently. Every new block now goes through a proofreading pass with Claude before it's saved, catching mistakes before they ever reach playback. The interval between drills is configurable per topic, so I can space them out or turn them off entirely.

Grammar practice is no longer disconnected filler: it tracks the same book I study from, gets checked for correctness before I ever hear it, and I extended verb-drill coverage all the way up through B2 and C1 level.
